THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_SWALLOW.descripti:
Swallowed cards are put into the [gold]Swallow Pile[/gold].
The [gold]Swallow Pile[/gold] has a capacity limit. Cards that remain for a certain number of turns are removed from combat.
Swallowing an enemy destroys it.
[b]Feed the Insatiable![/b]
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_SWALLOW.title: Swallow
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_SELF_SWALLOW.desc: If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of this turn, [gold]Swallow[/gold] it.
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_DIGEST.descriptio: Triggers the corresponding effect at the start of your turn if in the [gold]Swallow Pile[/gold].
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_DIGEST.title: Digest
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_DYNAMIC.descripti:
Refers to the DynamicVar value in each card's code.
Affects damage, block, energy, draw count, power, and other values.
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_DYNAMIC.title: Value
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_GULP.title: Gulp
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_INSECT.descriptio: This card counts as an Insect card.
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_INSECT.title: Insect
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_PILES.description: Refers to the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], and [gold]Hand[/gold].
THE_INSATIABLE_KEYWORD_PILES.title: Piles
